verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is a programmable payments platform with webhooks, a CLI and an MCP server, so asking about versioning and rollback of automations is a fair question. However, no evidence shows a product-native way to version, review or roll back automations. API versioning (docs-68), SDK migration guides, sandboxes and team activity logs are adjacent features, not versioned, reviewable or revertible automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
